lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
The sell-off for tech stocks worsens and drowns out strength elsewhere on Wall Street, The Canadian Press reports.
Pope Leo XIV has become the first pope to vote in a U.S. general election, The Associated Press reports.

Christa Pike said Friday that she remains in constant pain and struggles to speak a month after surviving a lethal injection in Tennessee, a failure she blames on “incompetence,” The Associated Press reports.
Before he captained the Starship Enterprise, Patrick Stewart commanded the Shakespearean stage, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
